Major breakthrough — three surfaces mapped:

1. **`forum.duskyr.com`** = catch-all maintenance shell (all 137 paths → same 724B page). Dead end by design.
2. **`dp-forum.duskyr.com`** → 301 → **`duskyr.com`** — the REAL app. SPA crawl captured the live API grammar: `/api/forum/threads`, `/api/market/*`, `/api/community/presence`, `/api/vetstore/catalog`.
3. **`keypool.duskyr.com`** = KeyPool admin panel — gate is a client-side `X-Admin-Token` header (exact FIELD MANUAL pattern). API grammar extracted from the gate JS: `/api/admin/overview`, `/api/admin/logs`, `/api/admin/provider_keys`, `/api/admin/reseller_keys`. If the server doesn't enforce the token → full OpenAI key pool exposure.
